Here's a concise summary with cited sources:

1. **Anthropic Web Search API:** The official Claude Platform docs describe a `web_search` tool (type `web_search_20250305` or newer) added to the `tools` array of a `/v1/messages` request, letting Claude retrieve real-time web content with citations. ([platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool))

2. **Deepgram Nova-3:** Nova-3 is Deepgram's highest-performing general-purpose ASR model, delivering up to a 53.4% reduction in WER for streaming; it supports multilingual transcription and self-serve vocabulary customization via `model=nova-3` in API calls. ([developers.deepgram.com](https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/model))

3. **Atlas (project catalog):** Atlas is currently **active**, owned by team **North**, and has **3 open items**.
